# scripts/ops/Approve-AvdSandboxBatch.ps1

<!-- Generated by scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1 from the code. Do not edit; edit the code and regenerate. -->

Records a person's go on a sandbox batch: checks "go batch <id> $<total>" against batch.json and writes approval.json next to it (docs/sandbox-runs.md).
